stage: precommit bounded paper-construction payload; publication attested by immutable child receipt
authorization: Current direct user instruction and attached user_instruction.txt authorize bounded new paper hypotheses, hand derivations, discriminating examples, concrete operation generation, targeted primary reading, evidence management and ordinary publication. They do not authorize scientific numerics, symbolic checkers, circuit build/compile, new grants/contracts, detailed scientific review or research-state adoption.
input_policy: Supplied task instruction and GPT review read and byte-preserved only in task-private local evidence. Their contents are excluded from GitHub publication; source_registry.json publishes bytes/SHA-256, provenance roles and reading scope only.

construction_result.specific_mapping: Active pair/spectator coefficient substitution, common angle generation, identity POVM/record law, shared resource accounting. Not a framework-inclusion-only or B_plus_core-only inference.
construction_result.limited_obstacles: Fixed active-axis simultaneous diagonalization and record-only residual reconstruction; no all-method no-go.

literature_scope.reading: Method sections only; exact requested versions and failed alternatives distinguished in literature_provenance.json

instruction_and_resource_observations.workload: Paper mathematics, primary-document reading and documentary Git/hash processing only. No scientific calculation workload or artificial resource caps; no shared settings changed.

instruction_availability: Local untracked AGENTS/current unified instruction are observed by hash, not invented fixed public commits. New worktree base AGENTS was read; latest user/root policies supplement it. Current common version 2026-10-17, older versions not co-normative.

preservation.precommit_observation: All HEAD/branch/status digests and both dirty-root staged/unstaged diff digests unchanged; only dedicated worktree added.
preservation.limits: Untracked content/ignored runtime/all shared processes or concurrent chats not comprehensively audited. No other job, environment or fixed resource contract modified.

manifest_excludes.reason: Self exclusion avoids recursive identities. Manifest itself independently verified as payload blob at publication.
Future immutable child receipt attests parent payload; cannot hash itself or be part of its own parent.

next_owner: User/GPT assesses this bounded technical result and separately decides any next research direction; no automatic important review or new candidate search.
mandatory_stop: After ordinary commit/push and final remote SHA, fresh independent empty-bare fetch, blob, bytes/SHA-256, fixed raw and preservation verification. No science, implementation, extra candidate exploration, formal adoption or reopen.

whitespace_validation.authored_public_files: Strict git diff --cached --check; private original whitespace/CRLF unchanged locally, not part of public diff.

publication_scope_adjustment.automatic_approval_review: Rejected proposed push containing nonpublic user-instruction and GPT-review original copies: explicit authorization for external publication of these private input contents could not be confirmed.
publication_scope_adjustment.safe_resolution: Do not publish original contents; preserve them locally and publish only identity/reading metadata plus authored research outcomes. No further original-content publication attempted.
